clips.title: The story
paras: The Test of Endurance is the second rite in a series of spiritual trials overseen by Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles. Having already proven their courage of spirit, Horde adventurers are tasked with pushing their physical endurance to the limit by infiltrating Roguefeather Den and drawing out the fierce harpy leader, Grenka Bloodscreech.

Dorn Plainstalker, dwelling at the Weathered Nook, takes it upon himself to temper young warriors before they venture into the wider, harsher world. Where the initial rite proved that a traveler possessed unshakable faith and steady nerve, this trial tests physical fortitude. In Dorn's philosophy, true readiness requires harmony between spiritual devotion, mental discipline, and the sheer stamina to survive sustained brutality.

The chosen arena for this trial is Roguefeather Den, a treacherous cavern tucked within Screeching Canyon west of Freewind Post. Swarming with hostile harpies, the cave poses severe danger to solitary wanderers. To complete the trial, challengers must carve their way deep into the subterranean roost, sabotage the harpies' gathered provisions, and weather the flock's ferocious retaliation until the matriarch Grenka Bloodscreech herself takes the field.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Grenka was powerful, even by traveler standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.
During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.
